target_customer: UK small and growing businesses running payroll and HR
problem: UK payroll providers paid the founders incorrectly at Monzo; small teams wanted fast, accurate payroll with HR records.
business_model: B2B SaaS per-employee subscription (listed from 5 pounds per month)

founders.name: Michael Colley
founders.background_notes: Named by Tide and Capterra as co-founder; not on YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: UK payroll needs HMRC recognition, RTI filing, pensions and tax code updates, which are rule heavy but well documented.

defensibility.rationale: HMRC recognition is required but obtainable; incumbents like Xero and BrightPay already served small employers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No copy sourced; fintech Tide bought Onfolk in October 2024 and folded it into Tide Payroll.

market_need_then: Founders were repeatedly paid incorrectly by Monzo's payroll providers; no market spend figures found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline Vaporising people admin; positioned as Gusto for the UK

rebrands.why: Acquired by Tide and folded into its app

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly name and clear positioning but modest press; name resembles unrelated folk CRM.

outcome_analysis: Onfolk was a UK payroll and HR startup built by ex Monzo engineers who had suffered payroll errors themselves. It went through YC Summer 2021, raised only a small reported pre-seed, and was acquired by Tide, which closed on 18 October 2024 for an undisclosed price. The exit fits an acquirer wanting payroll inside its small business app.
notes: Pre-seed amount and investors come from SeedTable only (Nordic9 says $125K total, Dealroom says $125K seed Sept 2021); treated as aggregator estimates. Mondaq says the deal was for the payroll solutions business; not settled. Price undisclosed. No dated competitor source from 2021 found, list empty.
